title: Standby or read replica
claim: A Multi-AZ standby gets each write at once and serves no reads; a read replica gets writes later and serves reads.
alt: Two panels. Multi-AZ DB instance: the primary copies each write synchronously to a standby that serves nothing. Read replica: the primary copies changes asynchronously to a replica, and reports read from its own endpoint.
notes: Brief 26 compare; 2-deep.md#a-read-replica-receives-changes-later-and-serves-only-reads (after the table). Title, claim and alt from brief.json.
